scope: Add a bounded ITSM acronym expansion to the existing deterministic reviewed-answer matcher. ‘ITSM’ and ‘IT service management’ match as CURATED_SEMANTIC with score 0.95; adjacent ‘service desk’ wording remains a near miss. Existing UI presents method and score, requires deliberate per-job selection and review, and records export provenance.
